item.description:
The Teaching of Shri Atmananda Krishna Menon

Source: TW

Author: Sri Atmananda Krishna Menon

Biography

P. Krishna Menon was born in 1883 in Peringara, near Tiruvalla in the state of Travancore (now a part of today’s Kerala). After completing the study of law, he became a Government Advocate and Inspector and District Superintendent of Police. He once said that in his early life he prayed at length to encounter a satguru, a teacher in the true sense of the word. One day in 1919, he met such a teacher, one svAmi Yogananda, who lived in Calcutta. They met during the course of one night only. Krishna Menon was particularly touched by the utmost humility of this teacher. He later stated, ‘This paralyzed my ego.’

item.title: Everything is Brahman
item.description:
Everything is Brahman Sri Atmananda Krishna Menon

Source: TW

Author: Sri Atmananda Krishna Menon

Read Ananda Wood’s essays on the Teaching of Sri Atmananda.

See the Recommended Books of Sri Atmananda

sarvaM khalvidaM brahma
sarva - whole, entire, all
khalu - indeed, truly
idam - this, known, present, this earthly world
- All this (universe) is verily Brahman
Chandogya Upanishad Ch. 3 Section 14 Verse 1

The Truth about this world is that the Reality, which is imperceptible to the senses, appears as this world when looked at through the senses. The ordinary man sees only the appearance and attributes complete reality to it. At the same time, he sees also the changeability of the appearance, but he shuts his eyes to it. All spiritual paths attempt first to show the Reality behind the appearance. When looked at from the Reality itself, there is no appearance either.
